details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its scripts)
B. The orchestrator poller and judges (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C. The clarify/plan/implement phase workflows
D. Documentation only (README, agents.md fragments)
E. Something else: the issue author must name the file, workflow or behaviour (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What problem should the change fix?
Choices:
A. A specific failure or bug: give the run link, the PR, or the error text (RECOMMENDED)
B. Performance or cost (run time, model spend, GitHub API calls)
C. Reliability (flaky steps, stalls, retries)
D. A new feature: describe the desired behaviour
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. Name the observable outcome or the test that should pass (RECOMMENDED)
B. Leave it to the planner to decide (not advised: there is no stated goal to plan against)
